cases.description: BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-valid-return: one anchor per distinct UC in first-use order, each authenticated, every leaf proven under its own anchor's root
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchor-not-admitted: B1 does not authenticate any anchor
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-final-anchor-not-admitted: B1 authenticates the first anchor but not the last
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-first-anchor-not-admitted: B1 authenticates the last anchor but not the first
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-expected-ir-hash: last anchor's expected IR hash not the authenticated one
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-false-opening: an opening with a huge timestamp for the same expected hash
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-empty-opening: no opening on the last anchor
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-ir-time-equals-latest-t: both IR timestamps equal the latest t
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-ir-time-before-latest-t: both IR timestamps one second before the latest t
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-mixed-rounds-and-times: different root rounds and later IR timestamps per shard, all at least the leaves' t
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-late-shard-covers-other-shard-leaf: shard 40's IR time is late but shard c0's is before the latest t of a c0 leaf
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-early-shard-other-late: shard c0's IR time is late but shard 40's is before the latest t of a 40 leaf
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-txhash-as-leaf-value: the tree commits txHash alone as the value
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-paths-swapped: the first two paths swapped
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-corrupt-path: one sibling corrupted
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-path-under-other-anchor: a leaf's path presented with the other shard's anchor index
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-too-few-paths: one path missing
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-bitmap-popcount: a bitmap that disagrees with the sibling count
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchors-swapped: the anchors not in first-use order
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-duplicate-anchor: the first anchor's UC twice: byte-identical UCs are one anchor
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchor-wrong-sibling-count-zero: an anchor UC with no shard-tree sibling under depth 1
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchor-wrong-sibling-count-two: an anchor UC with two shard-tree siblings under depth 1
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-single-anchor-two-shards: only the first anchor for leaves of both shards
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-foreign-conf: last anchor's configuration is not the policy's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-two-ucs-per-shard: leaves of one shard certified by different UCs: separate anchors, each authenticated
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-two-ucs-final-not-admitted: the last of several anchors is not authenticated

BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-shard-split-both-sides: earlier leaves under the parent shard's UC (depth 0), later leaves under its children's UCs (depth 1): both sides of a split verify, each by its own UC
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-shard-split-child-not-admitted: B1 authenticates the parent shard's anchor but not the children's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-shard-split-parent-not-admitted: B1 authenticates the children's anchors but not the parent shard's
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchors-3: three leaves, each certified by its own UC: three anchors (one-signature fixture certificates)

BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchors-max-dnb: MaxAnchors anchors, each certificate with four signatures (DN-B committee shape)
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchors-over-max: MaxAnchors+1 leaves, each certified by its own UC: one anchor over MaxAnchors
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-anchors-max-heavy: MaxAnchors (sixteen) anchors whose certificates carry 16 signatures each (the native maximum), the heaviest admitted shape
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-leaves-max-two-anchors: MaxLeaves leaves in two shards under one UC per shard
BRIDGE_COMPOSE_V1 of compose-refresh-later-anchor: the same leaves proven under later admitted roots keep their original t
